title: Zupee turns to AI as it exits the gaming business
script:
Zupee is exiting the gaming business to build AI.
Founder Dilsher Singh is shifting the company entirely away from online games.
They built their success on casual skill-based mobile games like Ludo.
The platform has accumulated more than two hundred million downloads over time.
The new strategy focuses on developing artificial intelligence products for consumers.
Leadership decided to wind down current gaming operations to fund this transition.
It is a massive strategic pivot for one of India's biggest gaming startups.
Would you switch from playing games to using its apps?
